name: HKUST Business School, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

program.length_note: 16-month Standard Mode (with summer internship) or 12-month Accelerator Mode

class_size.note: class size not stated on the full-time page

tuition_total.note: Program fee covers tuition, textbooks and materials for core courses and select co-curricular activities; school gives ~USD 77,500. Non-refundable deposit HK$65,000 deducted from the fee; payable in two installments. Same 600,000 HKD on https://mba.hkust.edu.hk/admissions/fees-and-financing

mandatory_fees_total.note: no separate mandatory fees listed; core textbooks included in program fee. Application fee HKD 500 (waivable).

living_budget_total.note: School table total HK$859,000 (~USD 110,740) includes the 600,000 fee and HK$15,000 optional field trips/travel, excluded here. Budget is for 12 months; the 16-month mode is not budgeted by the school.

scholarship.note: Merit scholarships and professional awards, automatic consideration; average award not published. HKUST MBA-Hinrich Foundation Global Trade Leader Scholarships: three awards of HK$350,000 each. Other named awards: Jebsen Educational Foundation (mainland China/HK residents), Terry Tsang MBA Admissions Scholarship.

employment.report_note: The MBA CSEA career report is behind a download form (not read). Headline stats from https://mba.hkust.edu.hk/full-time-career-development (Full-time MBA Intake of 2025, MBA CSEA standards). Salary, sector, function and location figures below come from the university-wide HKUST Graduate Employment Survey 2025, Taught Postgraduate (MBA respondents, n=42; may not match the MBA CSEA cohort), PDF https://career.hkust.edu.hk/web/public/documents/SurveyFindings_TPG_2025.pdf saved as research/sources/hkust-ges-tpg-2025.pdf.
employment.cohort: Full-time MBA Intake of 2025 (headline); MBA graduates 2025 (GES)

base_salary.basis: gross monthly income incl. commission, bonuses and allowances (not base salary)
base_salary.note: GES 2025 Table 5, MBA overall, full-time and self-employed respondents. Annual base salary not published outside the gated report.

by_industry_source.note: GES 2025 Tables 3 and 6, n=31; GES uses broad employment sectors, not consulting/finance/tech.

by_geography.sub: Outside Hong Kong (Chinese Mainland 5, India 3, Japan 1 graduates)

by_geography_source.note: GES 2025 Table 8, n=32 work base location

notes: Full MBA CSEA career report (salary by industry, top employers) is gated by a Mailchimp form at mbaoffice.hkust.edu.hk/career-report; to read via browser. GES salaries are monthly gross income (incl. bonuses/allowances), not annual base salary: do not compare directly with base-salary medians.
